Pulse 1.12.7

新功能

  • Antigravity 最多显示三个分组圆环，并可逐组关闭。 在 Antigravity 设置中打开「每个模型分组一个圆环」后，Gemini 4 Argon 的周额度单独显示为一个圆环，不需要的分组可以单独关闭。感谢 @iblueer 提议。
  • 读取 Gemini.app 自带的 agy。 只安装了 Gemini.app 时，Pulse 也能通过它自带的 agy 读取 Antigravity 的额度。#106
  • 小米按量计费账号显示余额。 没有 Coding Plan 的小米账号在圆环中显示余额，可在设置中选择圆环的计算方式并设置低余额提醒。感谢 @kahomesl 提议。
  • Command Code 显示工作状态。 Command Code 正在工作时，圆环上显示转动的标记，与 Claude Code 和 Codex 相同。

改进与修复

  • 带登录信息的请求不再跟随跨域跳转。 读取 Qoder、StepFun、小米、OpenCode Go 和 Claude Desktop 时，登录 Cookie 不会再随跳转发送到其他网站。
  • 切换站点后不再写回旧站点的登录信息。 从浏览器读取登录信息期间切换 Qoder 或 StepFun 的站点，读取结果会被丢弃。
  • 更换 Z.ai 或智谱的 key 后，卡片重新读取用量记录。 卡片不再继续显示上一个账号的历史。
  • 额外账号续期失败时不再误报退出登录。 网络中断、限流或服务端错误时保留上次的读数，只有登录被拒绝时才提示重新登录。
  • Command Code 的 deepseek-v4.1-flash 可以估算金额。 按 models.dev 上 Command Code 公布的价格计算。
  • 用量记录只有一天时也显示柱状图。 设置中的用量记录从第一天起就显示每日柱状图。

Pulse 1.12.7

New

  • Antigravity shows up to three group rings, each of which can be switched off. With "A ring for each model group" on in Antigravity's settings, Gemini 4 Argon's weekly allowance gets a ring of its own, and any group can be left off the panel. Thanks to @iblueer for the suggestion.
  • Gemini.app's own agy is read. With only Gemini.app installed, Pulse reads Antigravity's allowances through the agy it ships. #106
  • Xiaomi pay-as-you-go accounts show their balance. A Xiaomi account with no Coding Plan shows its balance in the ring, with the ring's basis and a low-balance alert set in Settings. Thanks to @kahomesl for the suggestion.
  • Command Code shows when it is working. While Command Code is working, its ring shows the turning mark, as Claude Code's and Codex's do.

Changed and fixed

  • Requests carrying a sign-in no longer follow redirects to other sites. When Qoder, StepFun, Xiaomi, OpenCode Go and Claude Desktop are read, the sign-in cookie is no longer sent on to another site by a redirect.
  • Switching sites no longer saves the previous site's sign-in. A browser read still in progress when Qoder's or StepFun's site is switched is discarded.
  • Changing Z.ai's or Zhipu's key reads the card's history again. The card no longer shows the previous account's history.
  • A failed renewal of an added account no longer reads as signed out. A dropped network, rate limiting or a server error keeps the last reading; only a refused sign-in asks to sign in again.
  • Command Code's deepseek-v4.1-flash is priced. It is estimated at the rates models.dev lists for Command Code.
  • Usage history shows its chart from the first day. The usage history in Settings draws its daily bars from the first day of records.

  • 圆环中的图标更大。 服务商图标填满中间的圆盘，更容易辨认。

New

  • The robot in the rings is now Agent Robot Avatar. The robot is an original character by CX ArtLab, turned on with Robot in the ring in an account's settings, where its colour, personality and shape can be chosen; off by default, and it needs turning on again where it was on before.
  • DimAgent support. DimAgent's plan credits, add-on packs and token windows are read through the signed-in dim CLI; turn it on in Settings. Thanks to @sunny0826 for the contribution.

Changed and fixed

  • A browser cookie store macOS refuses is reported as such. Settings asks to add Pulse again under Full Disk Access instead of asking to sign in again. Thanks to @momusticks for reporting it.
  • Larger icons in the rings. A provider's icon fills the disc in the middle of its ring, so it is easier to recognise.

  • 测试通知。 在「设置 → 通知」中点「发送」，立即收到一条测试通知，确认通知能正常送达。

  • Kimi Code 的用量记录包含新版 Kimi Code。 「Token 消耗」和 Kimi Code 设置页同时读取新版 Kimi Code 的会话记录，能识别模型时按公开价格估算。
  • Codex 会话不再重复计算。 同一会话同时出现在 sessions 和 archived_sessions 中时只计算一次。感谢 @Drswith 发现。

Pulse 1.12.4

New

  • Experimental: liquid docking. Turned on in Settings → Experimental, the rail stretches and parts like a drop when pulled off a screen edge, and is drawn in when brought near one; off by default.
  • Test notification. Press Send in Settings → Notifications to receive a test notification and check that notifications reach you.

Changed and fixed

  • Cursor usage is read again when Cursor encrypts its saved login. Pulse asks the keychain for Cursor's key, and after a refusal asks again only at the next launch or on a manual refresh. Thanks to @Hill-1024 for the contribution.
  • Cursor Enterprise allowances are shown. An Enterprise account that reports a single allowance shows it as the monthly limit, with amounts in dollars. Thanks to @lexleizou for the contribution.
  • Kimi Code's usage records include the new Kimi Code. Token spend and the Kimi Code pane also read the new Kimi Code's session store, estimating money at published prices where the model is known.
  • Codex sessions are no longer counted twice. A session found in both sessions and archived_sessions is counted once. Thanks to @Drswith for finding it.
  • The rail at the notch lines up with the notch. It is centred on the display and its corners into the screen edge match the notch's; at the small size with few providers, its top corners are no longer cut off square.
  • The detailed card no longer shows the "estimated at API prices" line. The explanation stays in Settings → Token spend.

Pulse 1.12.2

New

  • Daily and weekly recaps. Open them from Settings › Token spend › Usage recaps and switch between day, week, month and year at the top of the window to make shareable cards.
  • Token spend over a span of your own. Counting adds this month, last month, this year and a custom range with its own first and last day.
  • Qoder shows credit amounts and credit history. Show credit amounts in Qoder's settings adds each row's credits to the card, such as 5,843 / 6,000, and Qoder's detailed card and settings pane show the whole account's credits used and charged today, over 7 and 31 days, and day by day. Thanks to @momusticks for the suggestion.

Changed and fixed

  • Grok's cached and reasoning tokens are counted once. The cache hit rate, token totals and estimated cost now match Grok Build's own records. Thanks to @Edfghdrtxxx for the report.
  • Antigravity's cost estimate is more complete. Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low) are priced at their published rates, and an amount that still leaves out a model with no published price is marked with *. Thanks to @1206-skittle for the report.
  • A Qoder ring pinned to Credit allowance stays pinned after a restart. Thanks to @momusticks for the report.
  • Settings' sidebar icons are black, and choices in settings rows are pop-up menus. The icons are white in dark mode.
  • Shorter Russian names for the Token activity views. The switcher no longer cuts them off. Thanks to @winstik13 for the contribution.
